annotations.title: Get the result of an estimate you already requested

description:
Reads one estimate you already requested, by its estimate_id. Use this when a tier-3 (deep research) estimate came back with status "pending" and you want to know whether it is finished, or to show an earlier estimate again. Tier-3 results are only delivered this way (or to a callback_url, which chat clients usually cannot receive).

Returns status: "pending" (with retry_after_seconds: how long to wait before asking again), "completed" (with the same fields a finished estimate returns), or "failed" (with error_detail; any credits taken are refunded).

You can only read estimates made with the same credentials. Without an account you are recognised by IP address and browser or client, so a different network or client may not find the estimate. To find an id you lost, use list_my_estimates. Not for: making a new estimate.

Cost: free. Reading a result never spends anything.

api_key.description: The same api_key used when the estimate was requested (omit it if none was used, or if your connector is signed in). Estimates are visible only to the credentials that made them.
api_key.title: Api Key

estimate_id.description: The estimate_id returned by estimate_quantity_or_probability or listed by list_my_estimates.
estimate_id.title: Estimate Id

name: get_estimate_result

outputSchema.description: The estimate's status, plus its full result when completed. Fields that do not apply to the current status are null.

assumptions.description: The assumptions the estimate rests on.

billing.description: Who this call was billed to and what is left. Present on every Fermi result.

account_id.description: Account id; null without an account.

account_status.description: "created" if this call created the account, otherwise "matched"; null without an account.

anonymous_estimates_remaining_today.description: Free tier-1 estimates left today without an account; null for an account.

anonymous_quota_resets_at.description: When the free allowance resets (next 00:00 UTC, ISO 8601).

auth_source.description: How you were recognised: "bearer" (signed-in connector or token), "api_key" (the argument) or "anonymous".

charged_to.description: What this call drew on: the free daily allowance, account credits, or "none" (free calls).

credit_balance.description: Credits left on the account; null without an account.

is_unlimited.description: True for an internal account that is never charged.

confidence_level.description: Set only from coverage_probability: "high" for 0.95 or more, "medium" for 0.9 up to 0.95, "low" below 0.9. It is not a judgement of the estimate's quality.

coverage_probability.description: Chance the interval contains the true value (0.9 = 90%).

credits_charged.description: Credits this estimate cost (0 without an account).

decomposition_suggestions.description: Sub-questions (sub_question, reasoning) worth estimating separately to sharpen this one. Each would be a new estimate call at the usual cost.

distribution_family.description: Shape of the fitted probability distribution: normal, log_normal (positive and right-skewed), uniform, constant, beta (values between 0 and 1, used for probabilities and rates), triangle, gamma, exponential or poisson (counts).

distribution_parameters.description: Parameters of that distribution by name, e.g. alpha and beta for beta, mu and sigma for log_normal.

estimate_id.description: Id of this estimate, for get_estimate_result and list_my_estimates.

estimation_interval.description: The range that should contain the true value with probability coverage_probability. For a probability question, both ends are probabilities between 0 and 1.

next_steps.description: Ready-made input for neumann, Kromatic's Monte Carlo simulation server. simulate.root_node (distribution_type and distribution_params) can be added to a neumann model as one uncertain input; when the family has no direct neumann match, simulate.solve_args are the arguments for neumann's convert_range_to_distribution instead. simulate.note says which, and simulate.mcp_url is the neumann server to call.

point_estimate.description: The single best value. For a yes/no question asked with unit "probability (0-1)", this is the probability that the event happens (0.15 = 15%).

reasoning_summary.description: How the estimate was reached, in a few sentences.

request_id.description: Id of this request, for support.

research_sources.description: Tiers 2 and 3: web sources used (url, title, snippet, relevance_note).

retry_after_seconds.description: When pending: seconds to wait before reading it again.

status.description: Only on results that are not finished yet or that come from get_estimate_result: "pending" (tier 3 still running), "completed" or "failed".

tier_id.description: The tier that produced it (1, 2 or 3).

verification_flags.description: Tier 3: issues the second check raised.

verification_summary.description: Tier 3: what a second check found.

outputSchema.title: GetEstimateResultResult
